newsitem.title: SPAIN: GE Capital/BankAmerica buy into Spain's Cableuropa.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital/BankAmerica buy into Spain's Cableuropa.

text.p: U.S.-based GE Capital Services and Bank of America took a majority 32.5 percent stake in Spain's Cableuropa through their joint venture Spainco on Friday, Cableuropa said in a statement.
Spain Telecommunications Ltd (Spainco) bought the stake in the cable television and telephone group that was previously owned by Spanish firms Endesa, Union Fenosa, and Hidroelectrica del Cantabrico.

"The operation is the culmination of negotiations during recent weeks for the integration of an international technological partner in Cableuropa, and consolidates its leadership position in cable telecommunications," the firm said.

Cableuropa, which has licences to provide cable telecoms services to 1.5 million homes or 15 percent of Spain's market, earlier announced that it was expanding its joint operations with U.S. telecoms operator U S West.
Spainco's entrance into Spain's underdeveloped cable market was managed by Callahan Associates International, a development firm created in January by Richard Callahan, former chairman of U S West.

The other partners in Cableuropa are Spanish banks Banco Santander with 27.5 percent and Banco Central Hispano with 20 percent; Spanish builder Ferrovial with 10 percent and telecoms group Multitel with 10 percent.
Cableuropa plans to provide cable television, interactive services and basic telephone service for homes and businesses.
Callahan said the Spanish government was creating a dynamic telecoms market and that this operation showed a confidence in the Spanish economy and the growth potential of its telecoms market.
